Declaration Providing information about Data Usage and registering with Deutsche Börse AG are mandatory for Market Data Clients of Deutsche Börse AG; and Subscribers who receive information through a data feed and/or an API from Information Suppliers. Changes that affect the licensing of Information, must be updated by the Market Data Clients or Subscriber in MD+S interactive within 90 days. All other provided information must be updated or confirmed, as the case may be, at least once a year. Registration for new Market Data Clients The electronic Data Usage Declaration is available via MD+S interactive for completion. Subscribers register here: > Data Usage Declaration (Register) Information for Market Data Clients of Deutsche Börse AG In accordance with the General Terms and Conditions of the Market Data Dissemination Agreement, all subscribers of a Market Data Client who receive Real-time Data via a Data Feed and/or an API and/or other form of uncontrolled Onward Dissemination are required to provide information about their usage in MD+S interactive. Subscribers shall be informed about this requirement in the Vendor Service Agreements by the Market Data Client. The entitlement and Onward Dissemination of Information is subject to prior approval by Deutsche Börse AG. Exempted from the declaration are subscribers, who receive Information for display purposes only within desktop software (e.g. Terminal / Front-end solution) offered and controlled by the Market Data Client. Information for subscribers who receive information via information suppliers The Onward Dissemination of Real-time Information by an information provider via a data feed and/or API and/or other form of uncontrolled Onward Dissemination to subscribers is permitted only if Deutsche Börse AG has given prior approval to the information provider. Applications for approval can be made by the information provider or the subscriber via MD+S interactive or via e-mail to mds.agreements@deutsche-boerse.com. Providing information about data usage as well as prior licensing for the specific data usage by the subscriber is mandatory for granting requested approval. Exempted from the declaration are subscribers, which receive information for display purposes within desktop software only (e.g. Terminal / Front-end solution) offered and controlled by the information supplier.
